description: Lightdown's settings; Settings (Ctrl+,) writes most of them.

theme.description: The theme by name: dark and light are the built-in pair; Theme: Select theme lists every theme, bundled or in ~/.config/lightdown/themes and .lightdown/themes. Used when theme_mode is empty.

theme_mode.description: Empty to use theme; system follows the desktop's dark or light preference; dark and light use dark_theme or light_theme.

dark_theme.description: The theme while theme_mode is dark, or system and the desktop prefers dark.

light_theme.description: The theme while theme_mode is light, or system and the desktop prefers light.

theme_overrides.description: Colour roles to colours, over every theme; an object under a theme's name overrides that theme alone. Roles are named as in theme files: bg, fg, primary, keyword, ansi_red and so on.

icon_theme.description: File icons: empty or Lightdown for line icons in the finder only, Lightdown Lines for line icons in the explorer and tabs too, or the name of a theme in ~/.config/lightdown/icon-themes.

buffer_font_family.description: The font family code is set in, as fontconfig names it (fc-list); empty for the system's monospace. Font: Select buffer font lists them.

buffer_font_size.description: Code's size in pixels, from 6 to 60; 0 to follow font_size, at 0.86 of it.

buffer_line_height.description: Rows of code as a multiple of its size, from 1 to 3.

buffer_font_features.description: OpenType features of the code font by four-letter tag, as {"calt": true, "liga": false, "ss01": true}; a number picks an alternate.

propertyNames.patternMessage: a four-letter OpenType tag such as liga

ui_font_family.description: The font family of the interface, as fontconfig names it; empty for Inter. Font: Select interface font lists them.

reading_font.description: Markdown and plain text in Inter (sans) or Libron (serif).

lsp_auto_install.description: Install missing language servers on request, automatically, or never.

font_size.description: The documents' font size in pixels, from 8 to 40.

sidebar_width.description: The right panel's width in pixels, from 240 to 1200.

files_width.description: The explorer's width in pixels, from 160 to 1200.

terminal_height.description: The terminal's height in pixels, from 80 to 2000.

sidebar.description: Whether the right panel is open.

sidebar_view.description: Old setting, read once to move the explorer to the left.

auto_save.description: Save the active file by itself: off, on focus loss, or a second after typing stops.

items.description: A code action kind, such as source.organizeImports or source.fixAll.

code_actions_on_save.description: Code action kinds the language server applies before each save, before formatting.

modal_editing.description: Modal editing keymap. Takes precedence over the legacy vim_mode switch.

vim_mode.description: Use Vim's modal keys in editor panes.

minimap.description: Source overview; auto shows it for files longer than the view.

code.description: Wrap long lines in code, Python and LaTeX.

text.description: Wrap long lines in plain text.

word_wrap.description: Whether long lines wrap, by kind of file; unwrapped text scrolls sideways.

source_control.description: Whether the left sidebar shows Source Control rather than the explorer.

shell_integration.description: Mark prompts and commands in bash, zsh and fish terminals.

agent_check.description: Run a project's check command after an agent turn that changed files.

ruler.description: The column of the ruler in code; 0 hides it.

additionalProperties.description: A shell command that reads the file on stdin and writes it formatted to stdout; empty turns formatting off for the extension.

formatters.description: Formatter commands by file extension, over the built-in ones.

autocomplete.description: Offer names as you type in Python and LaTeX.

draw_math.description: Draw mathematics typeset instead of its source.

spell_dictionary.description: A hunspell dictionary name such as en_GB, or a .dic path without its extension; empty uses the session's language.

ide_context.description: Send the open file and selection to the agent.

show_reasoning.description: Show the model's reasoning in the agent's thread.

python.description: The Python interpreter; empty uses the project's .venv or python3.

api_key.description: The OpenCode API key; empty uses OPENCODE_API_KEY.

model.description: The agent's default model, as provider/model.

suggest_model.description: The model for suggestions and commit messages.

edit_predictions.description: Request edit predictions while typing. Overrides legacy auto_suggest.

edit_prediction_delay_ms.description: Pause before an automatic prediction, in milliseconds.

latex_engine.description: The TeX engine: auto, tectonic, latexmk, xelatex, lualatex, pdflatex, or a program's path.

limit_5h.description: A spending cap in dollars over 5 hours; 0 is none.

limit_week.description: A spending cap in dollars over a week; 0 is none.

limit_month.description: A spending cap in dollars over 30 days; 0 is none.

key.description: The API key; empty uses the <NAME>_API_KEY environment variable.

protocol.description: The request format: chat, responses or messages.

cost.description: Prices in dollars per million tokens: input, output, cache read, cache write.

base_keymap.description: The base shortcuts. keymap.json and legacy keys overrides apply on top.

additionalProperties.description: The keys of a shortcut; an empty array leaves it without keys.

keys.description: Shortcuts moved off their default keys, by shortcut id.

projects.description: Settings Lightdown keeps for each project, by its absolute path.

model.description: The model last chosen in the project; empty uses the default.

reasoning.description: The reasoning last chosen in the project; empty uses the default.

edit.description: Whether the agent may edit files: ask, allow or deny.

run.description: Whether the agent may run commands: ask, allow or deny.

web.description: Whether the agent may use the web: ask, allow or deny.

instructions.description: Give the agent the project's AGENTS.md.

limit_month.description: The project's spending cap in dollars over 30 days; 0 is none.
